title: Εικαστικές τέχνες
description: Ten reports, profiles, interviews, essays and a review about the visual arts in Greece and Cyprus: a Roman mosaic, an icon painter, pop art, a painter of the sea, poisonous paints, silk, a gift of paintings, fakes, a scouts' mural and soldiers' art.

lessons.title: Ένα ρωμαϊκό δάπεδο στον παραλιακό δρόμο
lessons.summary: A report: workers building a car park on the seafront of Patras find a Roman mosaic floor, and archaeologists explain how they save it.

lessons.title: Ο Παντοκράτορας του χωριού
lessons.summary: A profile of an icon painter who paints the Almighty and the angels in the dome of a new village church near Chania.

lessons.title: Μια κονσέρβα στον τοίχο του μουσείου
lessons.summary: An essay on pop art: is a painting of soup cans or a burger a comment on our lives or just advertising?

lessons.title: Ο σμήναρχος που ζωγραφίζει το πέλαγος
lessons.summary: An interview with a retired air force colonel who now paints the Aegean and explains what flying taught him about land, sea and colour.

lessons.title: Τα χρώματα που δηλητηρίαζαν
lessons.summary: A short history of painters' colours: from harmless earth and charcoal to poisonous whites, reds and greens, and how science made safe paints.

lessons.title: Η κόρη του μεταξιού
lessons.summary: A profile of a textile artist from Soufli, raised by adoptive parents among silkworms, who found her own way after the birth of her son.

lessons.title: Η συλλογή του εφοπλιστή
lessons.summary: A news report: an old shipowner gives his collection of Greek paintings to the National Gallery, and the gift opens a debate on taxes and private management of museums.

lessons.title: Πώς καταλαβαίνουμε έναν ψεύτικο πίνακα
lessons.summary: An interview with an art expert from Thessaloniki who explains how she tells a real painting or sculpture from a fake, and what it is like to speak in court.

lessons.title: Ο τοίχος των προσκόπων
lessons.summary: A group of scouts in Limassol cleans up a grey wall by a basketball court and paints a mural, while their parents bring food.

lessons.title: Χέρια στο μέτωπο
lessons.summary: A review of a small exhibition of objects, sketches and stamps made by ordinary soldiers in the First World War and in 1940.
